name: io.github.AbhimanyuV04/garmin-mcp
description: Read Garmin Connect health and training data in Claude: sleep, heart rate, HRV, stress, body battery, training status and activities, plus structured workout creation.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_TOKENS_BASE64
environmentVariables.description: Garmin OAuth tokens from `npx garmin-mcp-auth`. Optional: without it the server reads ~/.garmin-mcp/tokens.json.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_TOKEN_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Override the token file location. Defaults to ~/.garmin-mcp/tokens.json.
